text.en:
Section 17 of Presidential Decree No. 229 dated June 28, 1973, is hereby amended by adding
thereto the following paragraphs:
"aa) Any person who sells, furnishes, offers or takes intoxicating liquors on the day of the referendum.
"bb) Any person who, on the day of the referendum, holds cockfights, boxing, horse races, jai-alai or any
other similar sports."

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 23rd day of July, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-three.
